title: Ergs & EMOM - sample
notes: Sample draft. Review the supplied '2 EMOM' timing before publishing.

sections.title: Erg intervals
sections.body:
Row / Ski / Assault
2 min 20 sec ON / 40 sec OFF x 5

sections.title: 2 EMOM - x 4
sections.body:
1 - 15/20 cal Bike Erg + 8/14 Devil Press
2 - 12/16 cal Row + 18/24 Snatches + DB Squats
3 - 12/16 cal Ski + 20 Burpees
4 - 15/20 cal Assault + 20/30 Wall Balls

sections.title: Finish
sections.body:
Row / Ski / Assault
3 min ON / 1 min OFF x 5

title: Teams of 2 - sample
notes: Teams of 2. YGIG - share anyhow. Barbell 40/25 kg.

sections.title: Buy in - 80 cal Row / Ski
sections.body:
Partner 1 - Row
Partner 2 - 10 Burpees
Switch every 10 burpees until 80 cals completed.

sections.title: YGIG - share anyhow - x 2
sections.body:
100 DB dual Squats
80 Wall Balls
60 DB OH Lunges
40 Alt DB Snatch
20 SA Devil Press - synchro
10 Walk Outs - synchro

sections.title: After each exercise
sections.body:
4 rounds - YGIG
5 Barbell Clean & Press
9 HRPUs
12 Burpees
Barbell 40/25 kg

sections.title: Buy out - 80 cal Bike Erg / Assault
sections.body:
Partner 1 - Bike
Partner 2 - 10 Burpees
Switch every 10 burpees until 80 cals completed.
